intentions.title: Prove Barkpark's headless CMS with a real, polished Next.js consumer demo — not a toy
intentions.evidence: web/app/layout.tsx wires self-hosted fonts (no runtime Google CDN), FOUC-free dual theme seeding (mode + identity), Vercel Speed Insights for real-user Core Web Vitals; web/app/papers/page.tsx and (finder)/d/[type]/[slug]/page.tsx render production dataset content end-to-end via @barkpark/core and @barkpark/nextjs SDKs.

intentions.title: Ship an Obsidian-style finder: instant split-view search + document detail that never remounts on navigation
intentions.evidence: web/app/(finder)/layout.tsx hosts <Finder> in the layout (not children) so opening a doc via /d/[type]/[slug] swaps only the detail pane, preserving search text/scroll/in-flight queries; force-dynamic + server-seeded initial browse avoids CSR-bailout skeleton; prefix-seed index gives 0ms first-keystroke results before the live WS reply lands.

intentions.title: Give every document type (post, paper, sheet, page, author, category, project, media) one unified, correctly-404ing detail route
intentions.evidence: web/app/(finder)/d/[type]/[slug]/page.tsx KNOWN_TYPES set scopes both search engines; generateMetadata calls notFound() before headers commit for a real HTTP 404 (not a 200-then-throw); children (not a parallel @detail slot) preserves that 404 semantics per the layout's own comment; ISR revalidate=300 backed by getDocument's unstable_cache + on-demand revalidateTag busting.

intentions.title: Drive every page's social/SEO metadata from one write-time preview manifest, never per-surface guesswork
intentions.evidence: web/app/(finder)/d/[type]/[slug]/page.tsx generateMetadata calls metadataFromPreview(doc.preview, ...) — a single preview envelope (title/type/description/url/image/extensions) degrades gracefully to title-only for legacy unstamped docs; web/app/layout.tsx sets metadataBase once so every route's OG/canonical/twitter URL resolves absolutely, shared by sitemap/robots/feed.

intentions.title: Demonstrate multi-tenant workspace/project scoping as a first-class, navigable URL space
intentions.evidence: web/app/w/[workspace]/page.tsx resolves a workspace's default project server-side and redirects to /w/<workspace>/p/<project>; web/app/w/[workspace]/p/[project]/layout.tsx builds a WorkspaceProjectSwitcher from tenancy list endpoints (listWorkspaces/listProjects) with graceful degrade-to-static-label on fetch failure; per-request scoped @barkpark/core client via createClient({workspace, project}).

intentions.title: Bridge private, token-gated realtime updates to the browser without ever exposing the server token
intentions.evidence: web/app/v1/data/listen/[dataset]/route.ts is a same-origin SSE proxy: injects BARKPARK_TOKEN server-side, forwards Last-Event-ID, disables proxy buffering (X-Accel-Buffering: no), and propagates upstream failures/misconfiguration as explicit 502/401 rather than silently hanging — used by <BarkparkLive/> from @barkpark/nextjs.

intentions.title: Let one demo codebase serve two different landing experiences (docs graph vs. place-directory map) via a single config switch, with heavy interactive surfaces never shipped to mobile
intentions.evidence: web/app/(finder)/page.tsx picks GraphFinderLanding (Obsidian-style force-graph via public/bp-graph.js, ~131KB) or MapFinderLanding (Canvas2D listings map) by NEXT_PUBLIC_FINDER_LANDING, both gated behind <DesktopOnly> so the client script never mounts below md — a CSS-only hidden would still download/execute it on phones.
